source: Good Sam directory (PUBLIC_PARK and local-named rows with no entry within 2 km) and every named OSM tourism=camp_site/caravan_site with no entry within 1.5 km, read by name
note: Seven adds: Greene County's Kinser Park, East Ridge's Camp Jordan RV lot, Doe Mountain Recreation Authority's Roan Creek, the TRDA's Toqua and Lotterdale Cove on Tellico Lake (state, like Notchy Creek), Rhea County's Rhea Springs, and the Agricenter RV Park (nonprofit, private). TN held only 142 entries (12 local); the OSM listing also shows a real TN STATE-park gap (Big Hill Pond, Pickett, Meeman-Shelby, Norris Dam, Pickwick Landing main, Frozen Head...) and ~120 unmatched private campgrounds.
